problems.text: `publish_comment` treats a person's comment that quotes the marker as its own, so publish fails on every later push.
The how-to's pull request part says the publish job keeps a `!cancelled()` condition that the workflow it copies does not have.

goals.text: Publish keeps one comment per pull request whatever people write beside it, and the how-to says what to copy.

outcomes.change: Publish replaces only a comment that starts with its marker
outcomes.checked_by: a test with a fake `gh` where a person's comment quotes the marker: publish leaves it alone, posts its own comment, and replaces that one on the next run; the existing replace test still passes

outcomes.change: The how-to's pull request part says to add `!cancelled()` to publish, not that it is kept
outcomes.checked_by: an eval row that the sentence no longer says "keeps `!cancelled()` too"
